# purl.cr

> Crystal implementation of the Package URL (purl) specification

This is the documentation for purl.cr, a Crystal implementation of the Package URL (purl) specification (ECMA-427).

## Pages

- [purl.cr](https://purl.cr.hahwul.com/): Crystal implementation of the Package URL (purl) specification

## API Reference

- [Errors](https://purl.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/errors/): Error handling in purl.cr
- [PackageURL](https://purl.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/package-url/): PackageURL class reference

## User Guide

- [Basic Usage](https://purl.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/basic-usage/): Creating and manipulating Package URLs
- [Getting Started](https://purl.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/getting-started/): Installation and first steps with purl.cr
- [Parsing](https://purl.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/parsing/): Parsing Package URL strings
- [Type Normalization](https://purl.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/type-normalization/): Type-specific normalization rules
